--- traefik dev tmpl ---
http:
  routers:
    backend-dev:
      rule: "Host(`${APP_HOST}`) && (PathPrefix(`/api`) || PathPrefix(`/swagger-ui`) || PathPrefix(`/api-docs`))"
      entryPoints: [${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT}]
      service: backend-dev
    frontend-dev:
      rule: "Host(`${APP_HOST}`)"
      entryPoints: [${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT}]
      service: frontend-dev
  services:
    backend-dev:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: "http://host.docker.internal:3030"
    frontend-dev:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: "http://host.docker.internal:5173"

observation.command: cd /workspace && grep -rn "openapi\|/health\|swagger\|/api" backend/crates/server/src/startup.rs 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---"; ls backend/crates/server/src/ | head; echo "--- traefik dev tmpl ---"; cat .docker/infra/traefik/dynamic/dev-services.yaml.tmpl 2>/dev/null
